Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. Essential Functions Screen and review customer service inquiries. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:10.title: Business Development Manager - Electronics Manufacturing
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:10.description: Position Summary The Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for driving business development, cultivating strong customer relationships, and managing a multi-million-dollar book of business. This role combines technical expertise with consultative selling to deliver tailored process solutions for customers across multiple industries. The SM identifies and secures new business opportunities, manage a sales pipeline from prospecting through close, maximizes penetration of existing accounts, and provides expert-level product and application knowledge. Reporting to the CEO, the SM collaborates with internal teams and Production Manager to ensure profitability, customer satisfaction, and long-term growth. This role is well suited to a self-directed, results-driven sales professional with a strong background in manufacturing sales who thrives on generating new business.
responsibilities: Business Development & Sales Growth
Prospect, research, and identify new customer opportunities; plan and execute strategies to integrate leads into the business development plan.
Conduct market research to understand industry trends, competitor activity, and client needs and market conditions.
Maximize penetration of existing accounts by introducing additional products and solutions, including upgrading projects.
Develop and execute a business plan and professional portfolio to track and measure progress toward revenue goals. Prepare accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports for company leadership.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs, and use those insights to maintain business development strategy.
Collaborate with marketing, operations, and product teams to align business development efforts with broader company goals.
Track personal sales activity and results against individual targets.
Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with multiple contacts at each account to preserve and expand business.
Act as a technical consultant, educating customers on product specifications, applications, and process improvements.
Conduct on-site visits when necessary, to understand the needs of the client.
Provide timely responses to customer inquiries, support requests, and service needs.
Negotiate sales, pricing, and terms to reflect customer value while ensuring profitability.
Follow up regularly with clients to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
Reporting & Administrative Duties
Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, including pipeline forecasts and goal updates.
Maintain and update CRM to track customer activity, sales opportunities, and performance metrics.
Submit weekly expense reports, travel plans, and business updates in a timely manner.
Manage travel expenses responsibly, including vendor travel, hotels, and client-related costs.
Communicate effectively with internal teams to align customer requirements with company resources and SOPs.
qualifications: Proven experience in industrial, Distributor and manufacturing sales, process consulting, or technical account management. Electronics Manufacturing sales experience preferred, but not required.
Strong knowledge of industrial process equipment and ability to develop technical expertise.
Demonstrated success in business development, customer relationship management, and revenue growth.
Proficiency in CRM systems, forecasting, and expense management.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced growth oriented environment.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Strong prospecting and business development skills, with the ability to independently build a pipeline from the ground up. Existing Book of Business is preferred, but not required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab3d871d-40e9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in Portugal. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Implement and validate web accessibility in accordance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 requirements. Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices. Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate. Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment. Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems. Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality. Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation. Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities. Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bab78561-ebc2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solution Engineer (SLED & Water Treatment) based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to help protect critical public services and water infrastructure from evolving cybersecurity threats. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor to state, local, education, and water/wastewater organizations, helping them address complex IT, OT, and ICS security challenges. Working closely with sales teams and partners, you’ll translate customer requirements into compelling technical solutions and measurable outcomes. You’ll lead high-impact product demonstrations, workshops, proof-of-value engagements, and technical discussions with stakeholders at every level. The role also involves navigating public-sector procurement, regulatory requirements, and complex customer environments. Your field expertise will contribute not only to customer success but also to product evolution through direct feedback and market insight. It’s an impactful opportunity for a technically strong, customer-focused professional who wants to contribute to the security of essential community infrastructure. Partner with account executives and channel partners to develop new and expansion business across state, local, and education agencies and water/wastewater utilities. Understand customer requirements, technical challenges, expectations, and buying processes across IT, OT, ICS, and compliance stakeholders. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer journey, from initial discovery through solution adoption. Deliver compelling demonstrations of cybersecurity solutions designed for OT, ICS, critical infrastructure, and public-sector environments. Prepare, manage, and present detailed technical responses to RFPs and public-sector procurement processes. Support procurement activities involving state and local contract vehicles and other government purchasing mechanisms. Develop strong technical relationships with partners and increase their understanding of solutions relevant to SLED and water-sector customers. Conduct technical workshops, proof-of-value engagements, and post-sale transitions with municipal, state, and utility organizations. Represent the organization at conferences, seminars, and industry events focused on public-sector and water/wastewater cybersecurity. Work with customer stakeholders ranging from executive leadership and agency decision-makers to plant operators, engineers, and IT/OT administrators. Identify customer pain points and design practical technical approaches that address operational and security requirements. Collaborate with product teams by sharing customer feedback, field insights, emerging requirements, and opportunities for future capabilities. Requirements Demonstrated experience supporting sales or solution engineering initiatives with state, local, or education government accounts and/or water and wastewater utilities. Proven track record of developing new business and expanding existing relationships with public-sector or utility customers. Strong ability to lead technical discussions with stakeholders at all organizational levels, from executive leadership to plant operators and IT/OT administrators. Excellent presentation, communication, demonstration, and technical storytelling skills. Working knowledge of OT, ICS, and SCADA environments, including the operational considerations associated with industrial infrastructure. Awareness of cybersecurity regulations and compliance requirements affecting water utilities, including relevant federal and state requirements. Familiarity with public-sector procurement processes and contract vehicles such as GSA Schedule, SEWP, and state or local contracts is an advantage. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Що ми пропонуємо? — Дистанційну роботу у фіксованому графіку 3/3 — 3 робочі дні та 3 дні вихідних (у середньому 15–16 змін на місяць); — Чітку структуру робочого циклу: - Ранкова зміна : 07:00–15:00; - Вечірня зміна: 14:00–22:00; - Нічна зміна: 21:00–05:00. — Оплачуване навчання та випробувальний термін; — Внутрішня система мотивації — винагородження топперформерів матеріальними подарунками та додатковими бонусами; — 14 днів на рік оплачуваної відпустки, медичне страхування; — Додаткові тренінги та лекції для розвитку професійних скілів; — Можливості для професійного зростання всередині компанії. Що для нас важливо: — Знання англійської мови на рівні Intermediate+; — Уважність до деталей; — Здатність швидко навчатись та запам’ятовувати інформацію; — Адаптивність до змін; — Рівень впевненого користувача ПК; — Комунікативні навички; — Вміння аналізувати інформацію та формулювати висновки; — Вміння самостійно регулювати свій робочий час (в ідеалі — раніше працював(-ла) віддалено та на нічних змінах). Додатковою перевагою буде знання інших мов (іспанська, китайська, французька, німецька, португальська) чи попередній досвід роботи модератором контенту. Які виклики тебе чекають: — Модерувати контент на сайті: медіа- та текстовий контент, інші сервіси, а також здійснювати верифікацію користувацьких акаунтів; — За потреби долучатися до інших завдань: підтримання бази знань, додаткові перевірки контенту, зокрема для навчання ML-моделей, проведення рісьорчів тощо; — Співпрацювати з командою підтримки користувачів та іншими дотичними департаментами. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:24088f47-4bb.title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Spanish (Peru)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:24088f47-4bb.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level Spanish (Peru) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level Spanish (Peru) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $35.00 USD per hour

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:368fb12e-d9b.title: Project Epsilon - Turkish Quality Control Specialist
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:368fb12e-d9b.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answers Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team Ensure Trainer output meets the project's quality bar before final sign-off Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution What We're Looking For Native/Strong proficiency at Turkish Bachelor's degree required Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, data review, data annotation or data labeling is a plus Reliable access to a computer and internet connection Work Format & Compensation Work Type: freelance, remote Hours/Schedule: 20 hours per week Compensation: $32.4/hr Duration: Long-term
